Home.eyebrow: Germany · for Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking candidates
Home.title: Your direct route to your next job in Europe.
Home.subtitle: {brand} connects you with verified temporary work agencies in Central Europe, and lets you see who would be hiring you before you give your name. We start with Germany.
Home.note: Candidates are never charged. Browsing jobs is free and needs no account.

how.title: How it works

account.title: You create your account and fill in your profile
account.body: Your experience, your level of English and what you need in order to move. It takes a few minutes on your phone.

documents.title: You upload your documents and a person reviews them
documents.body: Your ID document and your CV. The review is not done by an algorithm, and until it is done you are not visible to any agency.

pool.title: Agencies see you pseudonymised
pool.body: They see “Carlos M.” and your experience. They do not see your full surname, your email or your documents.

consent.title: You decide who opens each document
consent.body: An agency that wants to see a document of yours has to ask you. You grant or refuse, silence grants nothing, and you can revoke a permission you already gave.

how.hook: Four steps, and you pay nothing in any of them.

privacy.title: What an agency sees about you, and what it does not
privacy.intro: This is not a statement of intent. An agency has no read permission on the tables where your contact details and your documents live: the restriction is enforced in the database, not on the screen.
sees: Your first name and the initial of your surname, in the form “Carlos M.”.
Your calculated age, your city, your country of residence and your nationality.
Your work experience and the sectors you have it in.
Your level of English, whether you are available and whether you need housing or transport.
privacy.neverTitle: What it does not see without your permission
never: Your full surname, your email address and your phone number.
Your postal address and your exact date of birth.
Any of your documents: ID card, passport, CV, driving licence, tax identification.
Your IBAN, which on top of that is never shared with an agency, not even with your permission.
privacy.nothingAsked: And there are details {brand} does not even ask you for today: no IBAN, no postal address, no phone number.
privacy.link: How your profile is shared, field by field
privacy.hook: Not a promise made in good faith: a permission the agency does not have.

cost.title: What this costs you
cost.body: Nothing, and it is not a launch offer: charging a candidate for access to a job is prohibited in the European Union. No commission on your wage, no subscription, no paying to feature your profile.
cost.who: {brand} charges nobody today: there is no payment gateway at all. The day there is one, the agency is who pays.
cost.hook: Zero, and not just for now: there is no payment gateway at all.
